what.text: This page follows refugees from Vietnam living in Switzerland, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 688 Vietnamese refugees in Switzerland, 3.3% of all refugees from Vietnam.
France hosts the most Vietnamese refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Germany and Thailand.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Vietnam in these years: an interstate armed conflict with China in 1988.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1993 to 1999.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at its highest figure, 6082 refugees.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Switzerland.
These are year-end totals for Switzerland only, reported to UNHCR.
